mapper.sql: select b.borrow_id, b.asset_id, a.asset_name, a.asset_code, b.user_id, u.user_name, b.quantity, b.reserve_start_time, b.reserve_end_time, b.borrow_time, b.expected_return_time, b.actual_return_time, b.status, b.reject_reason, b.approval_by, b.approval_time, b.overdue_days, b.overdue_reason, b.review_quality_score, b.review_package_score, b.review_service_score, b.review_content, b.review_time, b.review_by, b.del_flag, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark from sp_equipment_borrow b left join sp_equipment_asset a on b.asset_id = a.asset_id left join sys_user u on b.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select:
b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '5'
and (b.overdue_reason is null or b.overdue_reason = '')
order by b.overdue_days desc, b.borrow_id desc

select count(1) as totalOverdue, ifnull(sum(case when b.overdue_days >= 7 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as severeOverdue, ifnull(sum(case when date(b.update_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as todayNewOverdue, ifnull(sum(case when b.overdue_reason is null or b.overdue_reason = '' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingReasonFill, round(ifnull(avg(case when b.overdue_days > 0 then b.overdue_days end), 0), 1) as avgOverdueDays from sp_equipment_borrow b where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '5'

select case when b.overdue_reason is null or b.overdue_reason = '' then '未回填' else b.overdue_reason end as reasonLabel, count(1) as total from sp_equipment_borrow b where b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '5' group by case when b.overdue_reason is null or b.overdue_reason = '' then '未回填' else b.overdue_reason end order by total desc limit 8
mapper.insert: insert into sp_equipment_borrow ( asset_id, user_id, quantity, reserve_start_time, reserve_end_time, expected_return_time, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{assetId}, #{userId}, #{quantity}, #{reserveStartTime}, #{reserveEndTime}, #{expectedReturnTime}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update sp_equipment_borrow
asset_id = #{assetId}, quantity = #{quantity}, reserve_start_time = #{reserveStartTime}, reserve_end_time = #{reserveEndTime}, borrow_time = #{borrowTime}, expected_return_time = #{expectedReturnTime}, actual_return_time = #{actualReturnTime}, status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, approval_by = #{approvalBy}, approval_time = #{approvalTime}, overdue_days = #{overdueDays}, overdue_reason = #{overdueReason}, review_quality_score = #{reviewQualityScore}, review_package_score = #{reviewPackageScore}, review_service_score = #{reviewServiceScore}, review_content = #{reviewContent}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, review_by = #{reviewBy}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where borrow_id = #{borrowId} and del_flag = '0'

update sp_equipment_borrow set status = '5', overdue_days = datediff(sysdate(), expected_return_time), update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and status = '3' and expected_return_time is not null and expected_return_time < sysdate()
